chapter: Neko Is a Cat: Ding-a-Ling Metal Ball
act_title: Neko Is a Cat: Ding-a-Ling Metal Ball

quests.title: Neko Is a Cat: Ding-a-Ling Metal Ball

dialogue.t: Meow meow, when did that stone become the spitting image of me...
The stone human says that he will finish knocking on this stone soon.
Hibiki will be so happy when she returns.
Hmm, yes. This stone is good, but we must dress the shrine's surroundings up a bit, yes?
Please, help me hang these round, tinkling metal balls around the shrine.
These things were prepared by Hibiki. If memory serves, Domeki gave them to her because she loved playing with me and other children. It took quite a lot of effort to find them again.
"Bells?" I am not sure what those are, but Hibiki used to use these metal balls when playing with me.
She would put the metal balls on the ground, and then knock them far away. They would make this tinkling noise whenever they moved.
I do not understand what power they possessed, but the sound they made would always attract myself and the other cats to chase them.
I came to understand, therefore, that the reason why few people have come to pay respects is because the shrine presently lacks metal balls.
Thus, I request your help in hanging these metal balls in high places.
That way, humans will hear the tinkling of the metal balls and come to this shrine, and they will not lose their way.
The Offering Box will be full of Mora, and the shrine will thrive... and Hibiki will be very happy when she returns.
So, please help me hang these metal balls around the shrine.
Thank you, meow meow.
These metal balls will attract more people. That will surely please Hibiki.
Have you hung them all up?
Meow meow, wonderful. This will surely make the shrine a livelier place.
Hmm. Why haven't lots of humans come here yet?

dialogue.sit: I don't think they'll come so quickly...

dialogue.t: Ah, humans are so hard to understand. Well, you are an exception, of course. You are more enlightened.
There may not be any people now... But at least those little rascals won't get lost anymore, meow meow.
The stone human says that the stone will be ready very soon. Do come and see it.
...Hmm, yes, there was one other thing. A strange thing.
I went to ask those two green humans about Hibiki and Domeki.
Both of them said that they didn't know Hibiki or anything about her.
But the tall green human said that he had read about an "Ako Domeki."
He talked about... "bandit" this and "bounty" that... Whatever the case, he was trying to say that Domeki was a bad person.
There must be some mistake. Hibiki would always play with him, so Domeki must've been a good person.
That human's comprehension must be lacking. You're still the most reliable human after all, it seems...
Ah, when will Hibiki come back...

quests.description: Neko, “Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine,” seems to have business with you…
